title: The Plan tab shows the whole generated plan after one read and names an empty plan
requirement: Opening the Plan tab in the Project state panel must cost exactly one read of the generated plan view (state/views/plan.md) and no command, must not re-read on a tab switch, must list the initiatives with work left with their stage and confirmed-of-total count, the decisions newest first with their initiative and the open tasks, and must name both an empty plan and a missing plan view in words instead of drawing a blank pane.
steps: Run node .tmp/panel-plan/run.mjs: it mounts the production plugins/project-state-panel/client.js over the workspace's own state/views/plan.md and state/views/index.json and counts every read and command.
Click the Plan tab and record the reads, the commands and the elements built.
Switch to Requirements and back to Plan; record the reads again.
Compare the rendered rows with the numbers counted from state/views/plan.md itself (initiatives with work left, decisions, open tasks).
Walk the tablist with ArrowDown from Requirements and check the Plan tab is reached and selected.
Scan the plan view with the pinned axe-core, then load the two variants where state/views/plan.md is missing and where it lists nothing.
expected: planReads = 1 (state/views/plan.md), planCommands = 0, reopening the tab reads 0 files; 30 initiative rows, 4 decision rows (DEC-004 first), 6 open task rows, matching the file; ArrowDown walks board, map, trace, plan and selects Plan; axe reports 0 violations; the missing view says 'No generated plan in this workspace' and an empty plan says 'The plan is empty: …'.
failsWhen: The tab reads the yaml summary or a second file, sends a command, re-reads the plan on a tab switch, draws a blank pane when the view is missing or empty, drops out of the tablist's arrow order, or reintroduces the axe scrollable-region-focusable violation by making the plan pane scroll without anything focusable.
trigger: The owner opens Plan from the panel's mode list over the workspace's own generated plan view, then switches tabs and comes back; later opens the same panel in a workspace whose plan view is absent or empty.
oracle: The generated view itself: its header line 'Инициатив: 56; … с несделанными требованиями: 30' and its tables are what the pane must reproduce; the one-read rule is REQ-309; the empty state is the panel's own convention of naming what is missing instead of drawing nothing.
realism: The workspace's real state/views/plan.md (12 KB, 30 initiatives with work left, 4 decisions, 6 open tasks) and its real 484-task index, rendered by the production bundle in Chrome; axe-core 4.14.0.
